# Pages a crawler has no business in: they need a signed-in session, or they are
# one-off screens with nothing to index.
Disallow: /checkout/
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /notifications
Disallow: /saved
Disallow: /host/
Disallow: /artist/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /gate
Disallow: /bookings/
Disallow: /ticket/
Disallow: /tickets
Disallow: /lab/
# Search results are a different page for every word typed.
Disallow: /*?q=

# Lists every event, artist and venue with its last change. It is generated by the
# API (its address is in the sitemap's own URLs: all showzy.in), and named here, on
# showzy.in, which is what allows a sitemap to live on another host.
